answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 57 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an ivory bet on surviving 57 epochs of grading, and every knoll settlement recomputes the lotus schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 20 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 24 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
